ruled.by: delegated: design (agent ruling under CONDUCTOR_AUTHORITY_DECIDE_NO_ASKING_MOM; delegation_policy.md: agents decide nearly everything; listed in the owner's daily digest)
ruled.owner_words: we really need to reskin all the old junk around the map that looks like tanks, trucks, cars, etc. to be more Star Wars wreckage focused ... Then decide on the roster we actually want spawning, and finally re-graphic and re-text them (2026-09-12)
ruled.how_to_read: kinds = what a scav reads in the junk (what it was, what it yields, what it risks), each bound to the defs that carry it. cut = defs taken OUT of vanilla's junk scatter (gen_junk_roster_cut.py makes Patches/AncientJunk_RosterCut.xml from this file). Yields are what the game really drops (killedLeavings, from Core's defs); risks are honest: none of this junk carries a hidden mechanic.

zeddos_yard.law: Decades of hauled discards, sorted by nobody: the Hutts' yard. Laid by the Zeddo's Yard template (src/RimUtinni/StructureInjectionsRUT/Templates/zeddos_yard.txt, generated by gen_zeddos_yard_plan.py); its tile is also on the Fall Line, so no vanilla ancient-junk scatter lands around it.
zeddos_yard.switch: none on purpose: the yard's junk IS the player start site (PLAYER_START_SITE_1); a switch that removed it would remove the start, not reskin junk. Its pieces follow the scatter's junkReskin switch for art and text.

fall_line.law: Nothing here is old (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/fall_line.md, FROZEN). The RUT_FallLine tile mutator's junkDensityFactor is 0 (FallLineArrivals setting noOldJunk, default on), so vanilla's ancient junk scatter does not run on Fall Line tiles; the wreckage there is what falls (RUT_FallLineWreckFall, RUT_WreckList_FallLine). Its fresh kind: RUT_FallWreck_* (FallLineArrivals) and RUT_FallLineWreck* (UtinniPatches).
fall_line.switch: Fall Line Arrivals > 'No old junk under the Fall Line' (noOldJunk) and the 'Wrecks fall' group (wreckFallsEnabled, per wreck kind)

scatter.law: Every other surface map: vanilla's junk scatter GenSteps (AncientJunkClusters, ScarlandsJunkClusters, ScarlandsJunkPrefabs, ScatterRoadDebris) lay the reskinned wrecks below; the cut list takes out what has no Star Wars reading.
scatter.switch: RimStarWars Patches > 'Leave earth junk out of the scatter' (junkRosterCut) and 'Reskin vanilla ancient junk as Star Wars wrecks' (junkReskin: art and text)

rakatan.law: Megastructure debris is mostly not junk at all: AncientMegastructure terrain and the injection templates. Nothing in this roster is labelled Rakatan; the old-age register is kept for the megastructure itself.
rakatan.switch: the injection templates' own settings (StructureInjectionsRUT); nothing here is junk scatter

biome_wreck_fields.law: The Wreckage layer (src/RimMandrake/Wreckage: RM_WreckField_<biome>, RM_WreckWeathering_*): each biome mod's own wreck children of the RM_WreckFamily_* parents, weathered by that biome (sand-sealed, frost-locked, digested, scalded, irradiated, ...). Placed by the Wreckage mod, not by vanilla scatter; their art and text belong to each biome's mod.

kinds.name: speeder hulks
kinds.was: civilian landspeeders, airspeeders, swoops and cargo speeders
kinds.yields: steel slag when broken up (2 for a hulk or frame, 6 for a full landspeeder)
kinds.risks: nothing; the coils and cells were pulled generations ago

kinds.name: military hulks
kinds.was: troop transports, armoured carriers, assault repulsorcraft, checkpoint barriers
kinds.yields: steel slag (6 from a transport or assault hulk, 2 from a carrier, 1 from a barrier)
kinds.risks: nothing live; the armour still stops blaster fire, so it is cover

kinds.name: walker and war-droid remains
kinds.was: combat walkers, spider droids, scout walkers, heavy blaster emplacements
kinds.risks: nothing; the weapons are fused and the power cores gone

kinds.name: starship wreckage
kinds.was: starfighter engines, sublight engine blocks, crashed shuttles and gunships
kinds.risks: nothing; the drive cores were pulled out

kinds.name: droid and drive scrap
kinds.was: toppled droid shells, power converters, vaporators, load lifters, drive wheels
kinds.yields: nothing worth hauling; it is the ground the yard is made of

kinds.name: ship chunks
kinds.was: torn-off sections of starships and mechanoid craft that came down not long ago
kinds.yields: steel and components when a ship chunk is deconstructed; slag chunks and slag pallets smelt down to steel

kinds.name: cargo: crates, containers, barrels
kinds.was: freight: shipping containers, crates of every make, fuel barrels and pallets

kinds.name: yard and works structure
kinds.was: cranes, fortified wall stubs, pipes, shelving, generators, lockers, lamps, turrets, a squatter's rotted bunk in a cave

kinds.name: barriers and wire
kinds.was: checkpoint lines: concrete fences, razor wire, blast barriers
kinds.risks: nothing: the wire is old and only slows a walker down; the barriers are cover

kinds.name: dead old tech
kinds.was: beacons, cryptosleep caskets, pipeline sections, pollution machinery, a standpipe, a parts box, mechanoid slag
kinds.yields: what vanilla gives: a sealed casket may hold a sleeper, a parts box holds components, smashed machinery leaves steel slag
kinds.risks: a casket's sleeper may come out shooting (vanilla); the rest is inert

kinds.name: ruin walls and grave goods
kinds.was: the stone of buildings older than anyone's memory: walls, doors, columns, drapes, tables, urns, steles, a sarcophagus
kinds.yields: stone blocks or the stuff it was built of, when deconstructed
kinds.risks: a sarcophagus may hold what was buried with it (vanilla)

kinds.name: fresh-fallen Imperial wreckage
kinds.was: hull ribs, cargo sections, fuel cylinders and droid shells that came down from the debris lane days ago
kinds.yields: salvage when deconstructed (ShipChunk-style costs), nothing yet taken
kinds.risks: ship-vermin nest in it until it is stripped; the Empire watches what is hauled off the Line

kinds.name: biome-weathered wrecks
kinds.was: hulls, frames, cylinders, treads, speeders and droid shells, each reworked by its biome
kinds.yields: valuable resources when deconstructed (each def's own cost list)
kinds.risks: what each biome brings (radiation in the Wastes, heat in the Scald)

kinds.name: wrecked Rakatan stasis
kinds.was: Rakatan stasis caskets and vaults, older than the Republic
kinds.risks: what sleeps in the ones still whole

kinds.name: injected set-piece wrecks
kinds.was: a wrecked skiff, a sandcrawler tread section: placed by structure injections

AncientSmallCrate.label: small freight crate
AncientSmallCrate.description: A small freight crate of the kind every spaceport stacks by the thousand, emptied long ago. The metal has rusted too far to hold anything now. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientLargeCrate.label: large freight crate
AncientLargeCrate.description: A big freight crate from some old trade run, its contents sold, stolen or rotted away generations back. It is rusted through and will not hold anything again. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientLongCrate.label: long freight crate
AncientLongCrate.description: A long crate of the sort used to ship rifles, pipe or droid limbs, empty for ages. Rust has eaten the seams open. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientMilitaryCrate.label: military supply crate
AncientMilitaryCrate.description: An armoured supply crate in faded garrison markings. Someone cracked it open long ago and took whatever blasters or ration packs it held. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking. Its inner lining will still burn.

AncientSpacerCrate.label: starship hold crate
AncientSpacerCrate.description: A sealed crate from a starship's hold, its lock forced long ago. Whatever it held went off with the looters. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientCrate.label: old supply crate
AncientCrate.description: An old supply crate, broken open and left behind. Whatever was inside has decayed to dust and mould. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientBarrel.label: waste barrel
AncientBarrel.description: A broken barrel that once held some kind of industrial waste. All that is left is a crust of dried sludge on the bottom. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking. The residue will catch fire easily.

AncientStorageCylinder.label: fluid storage cylinder
AncientStorageCylinder.description: A big cylinder that once stored coolant or fuel for some long-gone outpost. The valves and pumps were stripped out long ago and the shell is too far gone to reuse. Breaking it down is slow, heavy work that yields nothing worth taking.

AncientLargeContainer.label: large shipping container
AncientLargeContainer.description: A full-size shipping container off some old freighter, rusted solid. It cannot be taken apart; the only way to clear it is to smash it, which leaves three lumps of steel slag a smelter can turn back into steel.

AncientSmallContainer.label: small shipping container
AncientSmallContainer.description: A small shipping container, rusted and completely empty. It cannot be taken apart; smashing it leaves a single lump of steel slag a smelter can turn back into steel.

AncientMediumContainer.label: shipping container
AncientMediumContainer.description: A standard shipping container from some old freight yard, rusted and empty. It cannot be taken apart; smashing it leaves two lumps of steel slag a smelter can turn back into steel.

AncientOpenContainer.label: open shipping container
AncientOpenContainer.description: A shipping container with its doors rusted open, holding nothing but sand and junk. It cannot be taken apart; smashing it leaves two lumps of steel slag a smelter can turn back into steel.

AncientMetalCrate.label: rusted metal crate
AncientMetalCrate.description: A small metal crate, rusted shut long ago. Pried open, it turns out to be empty. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientCratePallet.label: crate pallet
AncientCratePallet.description: A freight pallet with a few crates still lashed to it. Scavengers went through them long ago and left only empty boxes. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientWoodenCrate.label: old wooden crate
AncientWoodenCrate.description: A weathered wooden crate, a rare thing on a world this dry, but the wood has gone brittle and grey. It is empty. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking. It burns like kindling.

AncientChembarrel.label: old fuel drum
AncientChembarrel.description: A rusted drum that once held fuel. It is empty and corroded, with not a drop left. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking. The old residue will still burn.

AncientChembarrelPallet.label: fuel drum pallet
AncientChembarrelPallet.description: A stack of rusted fuel drums on a rotting pallet. Whatever fuel they held leaked into the sand long ago. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking. The residue will still burn.

AncientAmmoStack.label: munitions box
AncientAmmoStack.description: An old munitions box for power packs and blaster gas canisters. It is empty, and the few cells left in the bottom are corroded dead. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientCraneBase.label: loading crane base
AncientCraneBase.description: The footing of a heavy loading crane from some old landing field or freight yard. It cannot be taken apart, only smashed, and smashing it leaves nothing worth taking.

AncientCraneColumn.label: loading crane column
AncientCraneColumn.description: An upright support column from a ruined loading crane, rusted through. It cannot be taken apart, only smashed, and smashing it leaves nothing worth taking.

AncientCraneArm.label: loading crane arm
AncientCraneArm.description: The broken, twisted arm of a loading crane that fell long ago. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientFortifiedWall.label: fortified blast wall
AncientFortifiedWall.description: A wall of heavy armour-grade composite from some old fortress, built to shrug off blaster fire. It cannot be taken apart and takes an enormous beating to knock down, and nothing is left to salvage when it falls. It is airtight.

AncientPipe.label: corroded pipe run
AncientPipe.description: A run of old corroded piping lying flat along the ground; you can walk right over it. When it breaks it leaves nothing, and breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientPipes.label: pipe bundle
AncientPipes.description: A tangle of rusted old pipes from some water line or refinery, and no one can say how it ended up here. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientIndustrialShelf.label: rusted storage rack
AncientIndustrialShelf.description: A heavy storage rack from an old warehouse or droid shop, covered in rust. The shelves are bare. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientGenerator.label: dead power generator
AncientGenerator.description: An old power generator that once ran some outpost's lights and moisture vaporators. Its working parts were smashed or looted long ago and the rest has rusted solid. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking. What is left of its insides burns readily.

AncientMilitaryGeneratorSmall.label: field power generator
AncientMilitaryGeneratorSmall.description: A small portable generator of the kind an army field camp runs its lights off. Its fuel cell is dry and its motor is beyond repair. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientLockerBank.label: locker bank
AncientLockerBank.description: A rusted row of crew lockers. Every one was forced open long ago and nothing of value was left behind. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientLamp.label: glow lamp
AncientLamp.description: An old self-powered glow lamp. Its power cell is nearly spent, but it still gives off a weak orange light. When it breaks it leaves nothing, and breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientSecurityTurret.label: dead sentry turret
AncientSecurityTurret.description: An automated blaster sentry from some old security post. Its power core and targeting unit were looted or smashed long ago, and it cannot fire. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientBed.label: old bunk
AncientBed.description: A rusted bunk frame with a rotten mattress, left behind by some old crew. Someone can still sleep on it, though it rests and heals worse than a real bed, and it is too far gone to repair. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientFence.label: duracrete fence
AncientFence.description: An old fence of duracrete posts joined by duracrete panels. Animals still cannot get through it, while people pick their way through slowly. When it breaks it leaves nothing, and breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientRazorWire.label: rusted razor wire
AncientRazorWire.description: A stretch of old razor wire, rusted for so many years that it no longer cuts anyone. It only slows anyone pushing through it. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientMilitaryBarrier.label: checkpoint barrier
AncientMilitaryBarrier.description: A heavy duracrete block from an old military checkpoint. It cannot be taken apart, only smashed, and smashing it takes a long time and leaves nothing worth taking.

AncientBarrierLong.label: long duracrete barrier
AncientBarrierLong.description: A long duracrete barrier laid down to stop speeders and swoops. It cannot be taken apart, only smashed, and smashing it leaves nothing worth taking.

AncientConcreteBarrier.label: duracrete traffic block
AncientConcreteBarrier.description: A duracrete block from some long-gone spaceport's traffic lanes, cracked and weathered. There is still a little steel rebar inside that can be recovered when it is broken down or smashed.

AncientCryptosleepCasket.label: old cryosleep pod
AncientCryptosleepCasket.description: A cryosleep pod from some long-lost starship, still sealed. It may hold a sleeper, and whoever wakes could be friendly or come out shooting. Taken apart it gives steel and a little uranium; if it is destroyed it bursts into flame and leaves scrap steel and uranium behind.

AncientShipBeacon.label: dead nav beacon
AncientShipBeacon.description: A broken starship navigation beacon that once guided ships down to a landing field. Every useful part was looted long ago. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientMechDropBeacon.label: droid drop beacon
AncientMechDropBeacon.description: The broken shell of a beacon that once called battle droids down from orbit. Its working parts are gone and the shell has rotted after many years. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientBox_ComponentIndustrial.label: salvaged parts box
AncientBox_ComponentIndustrial.description: A battered box of salvaged machine parts. Some of them still work: opening it gives a handful of components.

AncientPipelineSection.label: pipeline section
AncientPipelineSection.description: A section of an old long-distance pipeline that once moved fuel or water across the wastes. It was stripped long ago. Taking it apart yields nothing, but smashing it leaves six lumps of steel slag a smelter can turn back into steel.

AncientToxifierGenerator.label: dead toxifier
AncientToxifierGenerator.description: A machine that once pumped poison into the air and soil, the kind an occupying army leaves running to make a world unlivable. Its valuable parts are gone and it no longer works or pollutes. Smashing it leaves a lump of steel slag and nothing else.

AncientBandNode.label: dead droid relay node
AncientBandNode.description: An old relay node that once let a commander control a larger force of droids. Its valuable parts are gone and the rest has decayed to junk. Smashing it leaves a lump of steel slag and nothing else.

AncientHydrant.label: dry standpipe
AncientHydrant.description: A red-capped standpipe from some old water line. It has been dry for generations, and no one can say why it is out here. Breaking it down yields nothing worth taking.

AncientPallet_SteelSlag.label: scrap metal pallet
AncientPallet_SteelSlag.description: A pallet heaped with old durasteel scrap. Opening it up gives a good haul of steel.
